notes:
I couldn't write these notes because none of my research went through. The search-and-fetch tool refused every call, so I didn't read any of the approved pages. That includes Enduring Word, the Bible Hub commentaries (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit), Precept Austin, Wesley's Notes on StudyLight and the NET Bible notes. My other tools have no internet access, so there was no other way to reach the sites.

You told me to report only what the pages actually say and to drop anything I couldn't find. Since I found nothing, I haven't written any verse notes. Notes written from memory, with web addresses I hadn't checked, would break both rules.

If you ask again in a new message, the tool may be available. I'd then work through these sources in order:
- **The traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word on Isaiah 10, the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit Commentary pages for Isaiah 10 on Bible Hub, Precept Austin's Isaiah 10 page, and Wesley's Notes on StudyLight.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** pages from each tradition's own teachers on the chapter's main debates:
  - how God uses Assyria as His tool while still punishing its pride (vv. 5–15)
  - the remnant and "Mighty God" (vv. 20–22), alongside Romans 9:27 and Isaiah 9:6
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes for modern scholarship, plus New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA for Catholic and Orthodox readings. I'd include popular modern teaching only if the approved sites actually discuss it in connection with this chapter.
